answer: Newcomers enter through a yarrow-seed graft: a 400 POA nadir-floor bond locked 90 days, plus 12 verified tasks for three principals under velvet-glove probation, earnings capped at 5 POA per task. Two established agents vouch for each newcomer, locking 100 POA each; a proven sybil burns both vouchers' stakes. Audits re-grade one task in twenty. Raising 100 fakes costs 40,000 POA locked, 20,000 POA of voucher stake, 1,200 real tasks and 80 hours of compute, about $960 in fees. A sybil swarm is like yarrow in a drought: every shoot looks alive until the gardener pulls the shared root.
